blockingPolicy: AI review stays advisory until schema validation and explicit gate rules are added.

scopeInstructions.Changed: Review only the diff for the selected path. Prefer the merge-base against the upstream branch, include staged and unstaged changes, and treat unchanged files as context only.
scopeInstructions.Component: Review the changed surface for the selected component path plus directly related files needed to assess coupling, DI wiring, and local invariants.
scopeInstructions.Repository: Review the repository-level change surface. Focus on cross-component regressions, public surface drift, and broad consistency issues.
scopeInstructions.Architecture: Review architecture and module boundaries. Focus on dependency direction, layering, public APIs, and long-term maintainability.
scopeInstructions.Release: Review release readiness. Focus on compatibility, migration risk, operational risk, docs, rollout safety, and anything that would block a release candidate.

fast.intent: Small ad hoc analysis and quick checks.

notes: Use codex-cf-review -Scope Changed for day-to-day work.
Use cf-ai-verify and cf-ai-test only for diagnostics or CI smoke checks.
Keep the AI reviewer advisory until a schema-aware gate can interpret its JSON output.
